items.en_title: Bocaina de Minas (MG) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #007
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Bocaina de Minas (MG) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 75,600; proposals close Nov 24, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
